messages:
Ivy (SDR): Hey all, first week here — HubSpot shows me but the saved views for 'Inbound - EMEA' are missing, Dialpad isn't letting me set caller ID to 'Redwood - EMEA', and I can't find the quick sell one-pager. Who do I ping for each?

onboarding-bot: Welcome Ivy (SDR) to #sales! You've been added to the SDR cohort and assigned a buddy: Noor. Check your onboarding checklist email.

Jules (Sales Ops): Welcome! For saved views I usually push them from a template. What's your HubSpot email? I'll grant you access and share the view link. Quick-sell one-pager is in Drive > Sales > OnePagers > SDR; I'll drop it in your bundle.

Ivy (SDR): ivy@redwood.ai. Thanks Jules. Also curious who orders the printed wallet cards?

Marco (IT): @Ivy I toggled the Dialpad caller ID to 'Redwood - EMEA' for your number; try logging out and back in. If the UI still shows old value, clear app cache or use web client at https://dialpad.redwood.ai.

Jules (Sales Ops): Ivy 3 added you to the HubSpot saved view "Inbound - EMEA" and shared the link: https://redwood.link/hub-inbound-emea. You should see a few sample contacts. If not, tell me and I'll reapply the permission set.

Ivy (SDR): HubSpot view is visible now, thanks. Dialpad web client shows the right caller ID. One-pager link received looking through it now.

Kira (Enablement): Ivy, for wallet cards ping me quantity and office location; I'll queue a print job. Also FYI the 30s openers doc for EMEA has localized language to reference EU data residency. Link: https://redwood.link/emea-openers.

Ivy (SDR): Can I get 10 wallet cards to be sent to the Berlin office? Also, any short tips for handling GDPR-related pushback on calls?

Kira (Enablement): Short tip: lead with value (e.g., "we reduce inference latency by X") then quickly mention data handling: "we're able to deploy privately in your VPC or region". If they ask specifics, offer a quick follow-up with a solutions engineer. I'll add a GDPR FAQ snippet to your bundle.

Mailroom-bot: Print job created: CARD-202 for 10 "SDR Wallet" cards, destination: Berlin Mailroom. Pickup ETA 2 business days.

Ivy (SDR): Perfect thanks everyone for the fast help. One last: where do I find the recent case study we can cite for latency improvements?

Jules (Sales Ops): Case study "FastQuery" is in Drive > Sales > CaseStudies > FastQuery.pdf. Quick link: https://redwood.link/fastquery-case. It's pre-approved for outbound use.

Ivy (SDR): Got it, bookmarking. Appreciate it see you at the SDR sync tomorrow. :wave:
